title: Real provider transport produces an audited envelope or declared silence

given.context: actual persisted Plant records filtered into AuthorizedPlantContext
given.executor: configured production DeepSeek or Gemini Agno model executor with valid credentials and explicit model id
given.definition: isolated test-only runtime_contract_smoke definition using the production assembler and executor; absent from production definition resolution

when.action: the project-owned AgentRuntimeService invokes the real provider once and receives either a strict valid non-silent candidate or a strict model-declared silent candidate

then.envelope_ready_outcome: outcome_kind envelope_ready, status envelope_ready, final_decision speak, clarify, or escalate, a valid pending_classification MessageEnvelope schema version 1, safe model_ref, and audit ref
then.model_silent_outcome: outcome_kind model_silent, status silent, final_decision silent, reason_code no_material_output or insufficient_evidence, no MessageEnvelope, a safe model_ref, and audit ref
then.accepted_smoke_outcomes: exactly the envelope_ready_outcome or model_silent_outcome above
then.forbidden_success: context_denied, runtime_not_configured, provider_failed, output_invalid, publication_guard_denied, audit_failed, skipped, xfailed, fake, fallback, or unaudited result
then.forbidden_content: no downstream product-agent completion claim, production registration of the smoke definition, raw provider response, prompt history, reasoning, credentials, fake output, Bus event, or UI event
